input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-restriction obligation on Sparkling. Fees are payable only per the Fee Schedule for the licence and services actually taken (§ 11, p0084), and additional locations trigger fees only if we choose to expand (§ 2, p0028). Maintenance runs on a renewable one-year term rather than a multi-year non-cancellable commitment (§ 10, p0065), and Sparkling may terminate the whole Agreement at any time on ninety days' notice (§ 17(b), p0118), so an exit exists. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "volume" and "quantity" returned no commitment language binding us. This meets the preferred position; no redline required.
